decisions.reason: As at 9:5, Peter uses the title for teachers of the law.

decisions.choice: Teacher
decisions.reason: Readable gives the meaning of the Hebrew title, as in earlier chapters. It also says what Peter remembered.

decisions.choice: "Ra-bi" (L, B), "Thầy" (R); Peter says "Thầy" for "you", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: A disciple speaks to Jesus with the noun of address "Thầy", which is what Rabbi means; nouns of address are always capitalised and take no setting (style guide section 6), so the English "you/You" span has no counterpart.

decisions.choice: "랍비" (L), "랍비님" (B, R); Peter speaks to Jesus in 합쇼체 and says "선생님께서" for "you"
decisions.reason: As the style guide's table and the Korean Mark 9:5 and 14:45: Rabbi as an address is "랍비님" at Balanced and Readable, plain enough for Readable where the English Readable says "Teacher". Korean does not address a respected teacher as "you", so "선생님" stands for the pronoun (as in the Korean Mark 3:32).

decisions.choice: Rabí (L, B); Maestro (R)
decisions.reason: As in English and Spanish John 1:38: the title of a teacher (meaning decision m3); Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: Rabbi (every level, Readable included)
decisions.reason: The French style guide keeps "Rabbi" at every level, as in John; it is a title of respect for a teacher (meaning decision) and is understood in French. The English Readable says "Teacher".

decisions.choice: "Rabi" at Readable too
decisions.reason: As in Mark 9:5 and John, the title is kept at every level: it is a known word in Swahili churches, and John 1:38 explains it as "Mwalimu".

decisions.choice: "Равви" (L, B); "Учитель" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew title, as the style guide does; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.
As in 9:5: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew title, Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: "ラビ" (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew title is kept at every level (m3), as in 9:5. Peter speaks politely to Jesus, as the disciples do throughout.

decisions.choice: "ご覧ください" (L, B); "見てください" (R)
decisions.reason: Peter's "look!" is said to his teacher, so it takes the polite request form rather than the command "見なさい".

source.text: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς· Ἔχετε πίστιν θεοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: And answering Jesus says to them, Have faith of God.

en.L: And Jesus, answering, says to them, "Have faith in God.
en.B: Jesus answered them, "Have faith in God.
en.R: Jesus answered, "You must have faith in God.

vi.L: Và Đức Giê-xu đáp lại, nói với họ: "Hãy có đức tin nơi Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu đáp: "Hãy có đức tin nơi Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Các con phải có đức tin nơi Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그러자 예수께서 대답하여 그들에게 말씀하신다. "하나님을 믿는 믿음을 가져라.
ko.B: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "하나님을 믿는 믿음을 가져라.
ko.R: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "너희는 하나님을 믿는 믿음을 가져야 한다.

es.L: Y respondiendo Jesús, les dice: «{{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} fe en Dios.
es.B: Jesús les respondió: «{{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} fe en Dios.
es.R: Jesús les respondió: «{{plural_you:Deben|Debéis}} tener fe en Dios.

fr.L: Et Jésus, répondant, leur dit : « Ayez foi en Dieu.
fr.B: Jésus leur répondit : « Ayez foi en Dieu.
fr.R: Jésus leur a répondu : « Vous devez avoir foi en Dieu.

sw.L: Na Yesu, akijibu, anawaambia, "Kuweni na imani kwa Mungu.
sw.B: Yesu akawajibu, "Kuweni na imani kwa Mungu.
sw.R: Yesu akajibu, "Ni lazima muwe na imani kwa Mungu.

pt.L: E Jesus, respondendo, lhes diz: "Tenham fé em Deus.
pt.B: Jesus lhes respondeu: "Tenham fé em Deus.
pt.R: Jesus respondeu: "Vocês precisam ter fé em Deus.

am.L: ኢየሱስም መልሶ ይላቸዋል፦ «በእግዚአብሔር እምነት ይኑራችሁ።
am.B: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ሲል መለሰላቸው፦ «በእግዚአብሔር እምነት ይኑራችሁ።
am.R: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ሲል መለሰ፦ «በእግዚአብሔር እምነት ሊኖራችሁ ይገባል።

ru.L: И Иисус, отвечая, говорит им: «Имейте веру в Бога.
ru.B: Иисус ответил им: «Имейте веру в Бога.
ru.R: Иисус ответил: «Вам нужна вера в Бога.

hi.L: और यीशु उत्तर में उनसे कहते हैं, "परमेश्वर पर विश्वास रखो।
hi.B: यीशु ने उन्हें उत्तर दिया, "परमेश्वर पर विश्वास रखो।
hi.R: यीशु ने जवाब दिया, "तुम्हें परमेश्वर पर विश्वास रखना है।

uk.L: І Ісус, відповідаючи, каже їм: «Майте віру в Бога.
uk.B: Ісус відповів їм: «Майте віру в Бога.
uk.R: Ісус відповів: «Ви мусите мати віру в Бога.

ja.L: そしてイエスは答えて、彼らに言われる。「神への信仰を持ちなさい。
ja.B: イエスはお答えになった。「神への信仰を持ちなさい。
ja.R: イエスはお答えになりました。「あなたたちは、神への信仰を持たなければならない。

decisions.choice: faith in God: God is the one trusted
alternatives: the kind of faith God gives
decisions.reason: The Greek says "faith of God". This form can name the one in whom faith is placed, as in "faith of Jesus Christ" in Paul. The sayings that follow speak of the one who believes and does not doubt (11:23-24), so faith directed to God is meant.

decisions.choice: have: a command
decisions.reason: The same form can state a fact (you have faith in God) or give a command. Jesus' answer to Peter is most likely a call to trust God.

decisions.choice: Have faith in God
alternatives: If you have faith in God
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts begin with "if", making the saying the start of a condition: if you have faith in God, then whoever says to this mountain ... (compare Matthew 21:21; Luke 17:6). The SBLGNT has the command without "if". Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: answering: responding to what Peter had said
decisions.reason: Peter had not asked a question; Jesus responds to his remark.

decisions.choice: faith
decisions.reason: Faith is a key term and keeps the same word at every level.

decisions.choice: You must
decisions.reason: Readable makes the command plain.

decisions.choice: "đức tin nơi Đức Chúa Trời" for faith in God
decisions.reason: "Đức tin" is the key term for faith at every level, as in the Vietnamese Colossians; "nơi" marks God as the one trusted, which is the meaning decision's reading.

decisions.choice: "하나님을 믿는 믿음" for "faith of God"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads it as faith in God; "하나님의 믿음" would sound like God's own faith. Keeping the noun "믿음" at every level keeps the key term faith, which the verb alone would lose.

decisions.choice: "विश्वास" at every level
decisions.reason: Faith is a key term and keeps the same word at every level (style guide section 6), as does the verb in 11:23-24.

decisions.choice: "神への信仰" (every level)
decisions.reason: The Greek "faith of God" names God as the one trusted (m1). Japanese "神の信仰" would mean God's own faith, so every level says "神への信仰", keeping the key term "信仰".

source.text: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὃς ἂν εἴπῃ τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ· Ἄρθητι καὶ βλήθητι εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, καὶ μὴ διακριθῇ ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ ἀλλὰ πιστεύῃ ὅτι ὃ λαλεῖ γίνεται, ἔσται αὐτῷ.

records.literal_gloss: Truly I say to you that whoever says to the mountain this, Be taken up and be thrown into the sea, and not doubts in the heart of him but believes that what he says happens, it will be for him.

en.L: Truly I say to you that whoever says to this mountain, 'Be taken up and thrown into the sea,' and does not doubt in {{gender:their|his}} heart but believes that what {{gender:they say|he says}} happens, it will be [done] for {{gender:them|him}}.
en.B: Truly I tell you, if anyone tells this mountain, 'Rise up and be hurled into the sea,' and does not waver in their heart, but believes that what they say is taking place, it will be done for them.
en.R: I tell you the truth: Suppose someone tells this mountain, 'Be picked up and thrown into the sea!' They must not doubt in their heart. They must believe that what they say is going to happen. Then it will happen for them.

vi.L: Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con rằng ai nói với núi này: 'Hãy nhấc lên và quăng xuống biển,' mà không nghi ngờ trong lòng mình, nhưng tin rằng điều mình nói xảy ra, thì sẽ được [như vậy] cho người ấy.
vi.B: Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, nếu ai bảo núi này: 'Hãy cất mình lên và lao xuống biển,' mà trong lòng không hồ nghi, nhưng tin rằng điều mình nói đang thành sự thật, thì điều đó sẽ thành cho người ấy.
vi.R: Ta nói thật với các con: Giả sử có người bảo núi này: 'Hãy nhấc lên và ném mình xuống biển!' Người ấy không được nghi ngờ trong lòng. Người ấy phải tin rằng điều mình nói sẽ xảy ra. Rồi điều đó sẽ xảy ra cho người ấy.

ko.L: 진실로 너희에게 말한다. 누구든지 이 산에게 '들려서 바다에 던져져라' 하고 말하고, 마음속으로 의심하지 않고 자기가 말하는 것이 이루어진다고 믿으면, 그대로 그에게 될 것이다.
ko.B: 진실로 너희에게 말한다. 누구든지 이 산을 보고 '일어나서 바다에 빠져라' 하고 말하고, 마음에 조금도 흔들림 없이 자기가 말한 대로 이루어지고 있다고 믿으면, 그 사람에게 그대로 될 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 분명히 말한다. 누가 이 산에게 '번쩍 들려서 바다에 던져져라!' 하고 말한다고 하자. 그 사람은 마음속으로 의심하지 말아야 한다. 자기가 말한 것이 반드시 이루어진다고 믿어야 한다. 그러면 그 사람에게 그대로 이루어질 것이다.

es.L: En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que cualquiera que diga a este monte: “Quítate y arrójate al mar”, y no dude en su corazón, sino que crea que lo que dice sucede, le será [hecho].
es.B: En verdad {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que si alguien le dice a este monte: “Levántate y échate al mar”, y no titubea en su corazón, sino que cree que lo que dice está sucediendo, así se le hará.
es.R: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} digo la verdad: supongamos que alguien le dice a este monte: “¡Quítate de ahí y tírate al mar!”. Esa persona no debe dudar en su corazón. Debe creer que lo que dice va a pasar. Entonces así le sucederá.

fr.L: En vérité, je vous le dis : quiconque dira à cette montagne : “Sois soulevée et jetée dans la mer”, et ne doute pas dans son cœur, mais croit que ce qu’il dit arrive, cela lui sera [accordé].
fr.B: En vérité, je vous le dis, si quelqu’un dit à cette montagne : “Lève-toi et jette-toi dans la mer”, et qu’il n’hésite pas dans son cœur, mais croit que ce qu’il dit est en train de se réaliser, cela se fera pour lui.
fr.R: Je vous le dis, c’est la vérité : imaginez que quelqu’un dise à cette montagne : “Va-t’en et jette-toi dans la mer !” Il ne doit pas douter dans son cœur. Il doit croire que ce qu’il dit va arriver. Alors cela arrivera pour lui.

sw.L: Kweli nawaambia kwamba yeyote atakayeuambia mlima huu, 'Uinuliwe, ukatupwe baharini,' wala asiwe na shaka moyoni mwake, bali aamini kwamba anachokisema kinatokea, atatendewa.
sw.B: Kweli nawaambia, mtu akiuambia mlima huu, 'Ondoka, ukatupwe baharini,' bila kusitasita moyoni mwake, bali akiamini kwamba anachokisema kinatokea, atafanyiwa hivyo.
sw.R: Nawaambia ukweli: tuseme mtu anauambia mlima huu, 'Uinuliwe, utupwe baharini!' Ni lazima asiwe na shaka moyoni mwake. Ni lazima aamini kwamba anachosema kitatokea. Ndipo kitatokea kwa ajili yake.

pt.L: Em verdade eu lhes digo que quem disser a este monte: 'Seja levantado e lançado no mar', e não duvidar no seu coração, mas crer que o que diz acontece, isso será [feito] para ele.
pt.B: Em verdade eu lhes digo: se alguém disser a este monte: 'Seja arrancado daí e atirado no mar', e não vacilar no coração, mas crer que o que diz está acontecendo, isso será feito para ele.
pt.R: Eu garanto a vocês: imaginem que alguém diga a este monte: 'Saia daí e jogue-se no mar!' Essa pessoa não pode duvidar no seu coração. Ela tem de acreditar que o que diz vai acontecer. Então isso vai acontecer para ela.

am.L: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፤ ማንም ይህን ተራራ “ተነሥተህ ወደ ባሕር ተጣል” ቢለው፣ በልቡም ባይጠራጠር፣ ነገር ግን የሚናገረው እንደሚሆን ቢያምን፣ ይሆንለታል።
am.B: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፤ ማንም ይህን ተራራ “ተነሥተህ ወደ ባሕር ተጣል” ቢለውና በልቡ ሳይጠራጠር የሚናገረው እየሆነ እንዳለ ቢያምን፣ ይሆንለታል።
am.R: እውነቱን እነግራችኋለሁ። አንድ ሰው ይህን ተራራ “ተነሥተህ ወደ ባሕር ተጣል!” ይለዋል እንበል። ያ ሰው በልቡ መጠራጠር የለበትም። የሚናገረው እንደሚሆን ማመን አለበት። ያን ጊዜ ይሆንለታል።

ru.L: Истинно говорю вам, что кто скажет этой горе: “Будь поднята и брошена в море”, и не усомнится в своём сердце, но поверит, что сбывается то, что он говорит, — тому так и будет.
ru.B: Истинно говорю вам: если кто-то скажет этой горе: “Поднимись и бросься в море”, — и не будет колебаться в сердце, но будет верить, что сказанное им уже сбывается, то так для него и будет.
ru.R: Говорю вам правду: допустим, кто-то скажет этой горе: “Поднимись и бросься в море!” Он не должен сомневаться в сердце. Он должен верить, что то, что он говорит, сбудется. Тогда так и будет.

hi.L: मैं तुमसे सच कहता हूँ कि जो कोई इस पहाड़ से कहे, 'उखड़ जा और समुद्र में जा गिर,' और अपने मन में संदेह न करे, बल्कि विश्वास करे कि जो वह कहता है वह होता है, तो उसके लिए वह हो जाएगा।
hi.B: मैं तुमसे सच कहता हूँ, यदि कोई इस पहाड़ से कहे, 'उखड़कर समुद्र में जा गिर,' और अपने मन में डगमगाए नहीं, बल्कि विश्वास करे कि जो वह कह रहा है वह हो रहा है, तो उसके लिए वह हो जाएगा।
hi.R: मैं तुमसे सच कहता हूँ, मान लो कोई इस पहाड़ से कहता है, 'उखड़ जा और समुद्र में जा गिर!' उसे अपने मन में शक नहीं करना चाहिए। उसे विश्वास करना चाहिए कि जो वह कहता है, वह होगा। तब उसके लिए वैसा ही हो जाएगा।

uk.L: Істинно кажу вам, що хто скаже цій горі: “Піднімися й кинься в море”, і не сумніватиметься у своєму серці, але віритиме, що станеться те, що він каже, — буде йому [так].
uk.B: Істинно кажу вам: якщо хтось скаже цій горі: “Знімись і кинься в море”, і не вагатиметься в серці, а віритиме, що те, що він каже, здійснюється, — так і станеться для нього.
uk.R: Кажу вам правду: уявіть, що хтось каже цій горі: “Піднімись і впади в море!” Така людина не повинна сумніватися в серці. Вона мусить вірити, що те, що вона каже, станеться. Тоді так і буде.

ja.L: アーメン、あなたがたに言う。だれでもこの山に『持ち上げられて、海に投げ込まれよ』と言い、心の中で疑わず、自分の言うことが起こると信じるなら、その人にはそのとおりに[なる]。
ja.B: まことに、あなたがたに言っておく。だれでもこの山に向かって、『立ち上がって、海に飛び込め』と言い、心の中で迷わずに、自分の言うことが今起ころうとしていると信じるなら、その人にはそのとおりになる。
ja.R: 本当のことを言おう。だれかがこの山に、『持ち上がって、海に落ちろ！』と言うとする。その人は、心の中で疑ってはならない。自分の言ったことが本当に起こると信じなければならない。そうすれば、そのとおりになる。

decisions.choice: moving a mountain into the sea: doing what seems impossible
alternatives: a promise to move actual mountains on request
decisions.reason: Removing mountains was a picture of overcoming the impossible (Zechariah 4:7; 1 Corinthians 13:2).

decisions.choice: this mountain: the Mount of Olives they were crossing, or the temple mount ahead of them
decisions.reason: They were on the road over the Mount of Olives, which Zechariah 14:4 says will be split. Some see the temple mount, under judgment in this chapter. "This" points to a mountain in view; Mark does not say which.

decisions.choice: doubt: be divided in mind, waver between two views
decisions.reason: The verb pictures someone torn between trust and distrust. Its opposite here is to believe.

decisions.choice: happens: a present tense, as good as already happening
decisions.reason: Faith counts what is said as already coming to pass.

decisions.choice: anyone ... their, they, them
decisions.reason: The saying applies to anyone, so Balanced and Readable use inclusive pronouns. Literal follows the Greek with a gender setting.

decisions.choice: They must not doubt ... They must believe
alternatives: and does not doubt but believes
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long condition into short sentences.

decisions.choice: "Thật vậy, Ta nói với các con" (L, B); "Ta nói thật với các con" (R) for the single "Truly"
decisions.reason: The single "amen" takes the form the Vietnamese John uses for the double one, said once: Readable uses the plain spoken way of stressing that something is true. Recorded once for the chapter.

decisions.choice: "진실로 너희에게 말한다" (L, B); "내가 분명히 말한다" (R) for amen
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Mark 3:28 and the Korean John's single form; modern endings replace the archaic "이르노니".

decisions.choice: No gender span: "누구든지", "그", "그 사람"
alternatives: a gender setting span, as in the English Literal
decisions.reason: Korean "누구든지" and "그 사람" already include men and women, so there is no second form for a setting to switch to (style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: En verdad les digo (L, B); Les digo la verdad (R)
decisions.reason: The single "Truly" of Mark, matching the Spanish of John ("En verdad, en verdad les digo"; "Les digo la verdad"). Recorded once in this chapter.

decisions.choice: no gender setting
decisions.reason: Spanish "cualquiera", "alguien" and "su corazón" already include men and women, so the English they / he setting has no Spanish counterpart here.

decisions.choice: En vérité, je vous le dis (L, B); Je vous le dis, c'est la vérité (R)
decisions.reason: The French rendering of John's double "Truly, truly", used with Mark's single word; recorded once in this chapter.

decisions.choice: quiconque ... il, quelqu'un ... il, with no gender setting
alternatives: gender setting spans on the pronouns, as in the English
decisions.reason: French "quiconque" and "quelqu'un" already mean anyone, man or woman, and the "il", "son", "lui" that refer back to them are ordinary generic French (French style guide, section 7), so French needs none of the English spans for "their", "they", "them".

decisions.choice: "Kweli nawaambia" (L, B); "Nawaambia ukweli" (R)
decisions.reason: Mark has the single "truly", where John doubles it. Swahili follows the form settled for John ("Kweli kweli nawaambia"; "Nawaambia ukweli" at Readable) with "kweli" once, so the two Gospels read alike. Used in the same way through Mark 11 and 12.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "yeyote", "mtu", "moyoni mwake"
decisions.reason: The English offers "he, his, him" as the traditional alternative to "they, their, them". Swahili pronouns and possessives ("mwake", "yake") do not mark gender, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: Em verdade eu lhes digo (L, B); Eu garanto a vocês (R)
decisions.reason: For this passage, as in Matthew and docs/portuguese-style.md, section 6: Literal and Balanced keep the solemn formula; Readable gives its force in everyday words, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: quem / alguém ... ele, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English Literal needs a gender setting on "his", "he" and "him". In Portuguese "quem" and "alguém" already mean anyone, and the "ele" that refers back to them is ordinary generic Portuguese, so no setting is used (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 7). Readable says "essa pessoa", as the English Readable says "they".

decisions.choice: "እውነት እላችኋለሁ" (L, B); "እውነቱን እነግራችኋለሁ" (R)
decisions.reason: The formula of Matthew, kept through Mark: Jesus's "amen" before his own words says that what follows is sure, and "እውነት" says that in Amharic; the Readable uses the everyday "I am telling you the truth".

decisions.choice: no gender span on "ልቡ", "ቢለው", "ይሆንለታል"
alternatives: a span copied from the English Literal (their/his)
decisions.reason: The Amharic third person masculine suffix after "ማንም" or "አንድ ሰው" is the ordinary way to speak of anyone at all, man or woman, so there is no second wording to offer.

decisions.choice: "Истинно говорю вам" (L, B); "Говорю вам правду" (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide forms of the style guide for amen with "I tell you", as in Matthew 21:21.

decisions.choice: "Будь поднята и брошена" (L); "Поднимись и бросься" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The same words as Matthew 21:21, where the Greek is the same: Literal keeps the passives, Balanced and Readable say it as a command to the mountain.

decisions.choice: "मैं तुमसे सच कहता हूँ" at every level
decisions.reason: The settled wording for Jesus's solemn opening (style guide 7b), the same at every level. The mountain is told "उखड़ जा और समुद्र में जा गिर", as in Matthew 21:21, where the Greek is the same.

decisions.choice: "कोई ... अपने ... वह ... उसके" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English Literal
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "their" or "his". Hindi "कोई", "वह", "अपना" and "उसके" are not marked for gender, and the verbs here are the generic form, so the saying already applies to anyone and the setting has nothing to change. The same for "मनुष्यों" in 11:30 and 11:32.

decisions.choice: "アーメン、あなたがたに言う" (L); "まことに、あなたがたに言っておく" (B); "本当のことを言おう" (R)
decisions.reason: The Gospels' formula for Jesus' solemn sayings, in the forms used through Matthew, Mark and Luke in Japanese.

decisions.choice: "心の中で", "その人" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs gender spans for their/his and them/him. Japanese leaves the possessive out and says "その人", which means anyone, so no span is needed.

source.text: διὰ τοῦτο λέγω ὑμῖν, πάντα ὅσα προσεύχεσθε καὶ αἰτεῖσθε, πιστεύετε ὅτι ἐλάβετε, καὶ ἔσται ὑμῖν.

records.literal_gloss: Because of this I say to you, all things whatever you pray and ask, believe that you received, and it will be to you.

en.L: For this reason I say to you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you received [them], and [they] will be yours.
en.B: So I tell you: everything you request when you pray, believe that you received it, and you will have it.
en.R: So I tell you this: When you pray and ask God for things, believe that you have already received them. Then they will be yours.

vi.L: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con, mọi điều gì các con cầu nguyện và xin, hãy tin rằng các con đã nhận được, thì [điều đó] sẽ thuộc về các con.
vi.B: Vì thế, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con: mọi điều các con cầu xin khi cầu nguyện, hãy tin rằng các con đã nhận được, thì các con sẽ có điều đó.
vi.R: Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nói với các con: Khi các con cầu nguyện và xin Đức Chúa Trời điều gì, hãy tin rằng các con đã nhận được rồi. Rồi các con sẽ có những điều ấy.

ko.L: 그러므로 내가 너희에게 말한다. 너희가 기도하며 구하는 것은 무엇이든지 이미 받았다고 믿어라. 그러면 너희에게 그대로 될 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 너희에게 말한다. 너희가 기도하면서 구하는 것은 무엇이든 이미 받았다고 믿어라. 그러면 너희가 그것을 얻을 것이다.
ko.R: 그래서 내가 너희에게 말한다. 너희가 기도하면서 하나님께 무엇을 구할 때에, 그것을 벌써 받았다고 믿어라. 그러면 그것이 너희 것이 될 것이다.

es.L: Por esto {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: todo cuanto {{plural_you:oran y piden|oráis y pedís}}, {{plural_you:crean|creed}} que lo {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}}, y será {{plural_you:suyo|vuestro}}.
es.B: Por eso {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: todo lo que {{plural_you:pidan|pidáis}} en oración, {{plural_you:crean|creed}} que ya lo {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}}, y lo {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}}.
es.R: Por eso {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: cuando {{plural_you:oren|oréis}} y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} {{plural_you:pidan|pidáis}} cosas a Dios, {{plural_you:crean|creed}} que ya las {{plural_you:han recibido|habéis recibido}}. Entonces serán {{plural_you:suyas|vuestras}}.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi je vous dis : tout ce que vous demandez en priant, croyez que vous [l’]avez reçu, et cela sera à vous.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi je vous le dis : tout ce que vous demandez dans la prière, croyez que vous l’avez reçu, et vous l’aurez.
fr.R: Je vous dis donc ceci : quand vous priez et que vous demandez quelque chose à Dieu, croyez que vous l’avez déjà reçu. Alors ce sera à vous.

sw.L: Kwa sababu hii nawaambia, mambo yote mnayoyaombea na kuyaomba, aminini kwamba mliyapokea, nayo yatakuwa yenu.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nawaambia: chochote mnachoomba mnaposali, aminini kwamba mmekipokea, nanyi mtakipata.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nawaambia hivi: mnaposali na kumwomba Mungu vitu, aminini kwamba mmekwisha kuvipokea. Ndipo vitakuwa vyenu.

pt.L: Por isso eu lhes digo: todas as coisas que vocês pedem em oração, creiam que [as] receberam, e [elas] serão de vocês.
pt.B: Por isso eu lhes digo: tudo o que vocês pedirem em oração, creiam que já receberam, e vocês o terão.
pt.R: Por isso eu digo a vocês: quando vocês orarem e pedirem coisas a Deus, acreditem que já as receberam. Então elas vão ser de vocês.

am.L: ስለዚህ እላችኋለሁ፤ የምትጸልዩትንና የምትለምኑትን ሁሉ እንደ ተቀበላችሁ እመኑ፤ ለእናንተም ይሆናል።
am.B: ስለዚህ እላችኋለሁ፤ በጸሎት የምትለምኑትን ሁሉ እንደ ተቀበላችሁት እመኑ፤ ታገኙታላችሁም።
am.R: ስለዚህ ይህን እነግራችኋለሁ፤ ስትጸልዩና እግዚአብሔርን አንድ ነገር ስትለምኑ፣ እንደ ተቀበላችሁት እመኑ። ያን ጊዜ የእናንተ ይሆናል።

ru.L: Поэтому говорю вам: всё, о чём вы молитесь и просите, верьте, что вы получили, и будет вам.
ru.B: Поэтому говорю вам: всё, о чём вы просите в молитве, — верьте, что вы это получили, и это будет ваше.
ru.R: Поэтому {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} говорю вам: когда вы молитесь и просите Бога о чём-то, верьте, что вы это уже получили. Тогда это будет ваше.

hi.L: इस कारण मैं तुमसे कहता हूँ, जो कुछ तुम प्रार्थना करके माँगते हो, विश्वास करो कि तुमने [उसे] पा लिया, और वह तुम्हारा हो जाएगा।
hi.B: इसलिए मैं तुमसे कहता हूँ: जो कुछ तुम प्रार्थना में माँगते हो, विश्वास करो कि वह तुम्हें मिल गया है, और वह तुम्हारा हो जाएगा।
hi.R: इसलिए मैं तुमसे यह कहता हूँ: जब तुम प्रार्थना करो और परमेश्वर से कुछ माँगो, तो विश्वास करो कि वह तुम्हें मिल चुका है। तब वह तुम्हारा हो जाएगा।

uk.L: Тому кажу вам: усе, чого молитеся й просите, вірте, що ви отримали, і буде вам.
uk.B: Тож кажу вам: усе, чого просите в молитві, вірте, що вже отримали, і матимете це.
uk.R: Тож кажу вам: коли ви молитеся і просите в Бога чогось, вірте, що ви вже це отримали. Тоді воно буде вашим.

ja.L: このゆえに、あなたがたに言う。祈り求めるものは何でも、すでに受けたと信じなさい。そうすれば、[それは]あなたがたのものになる。
ja.B: だから、あなたがたに言っておく。祈って願い求めるものはすべて、もう受けたと信じなさい。そうすれば、それはあなたがたのものになる。
ja.R: だから、あなたたちに言っておく。祈って神に何かを願うときには、もうそれを受け取ったと信じなさい。そうすれば、それはあなたたちのものになる。

decisions.choice: received: a past tense, the answer counted as already given
decisions.reason: Jesus tells them to believe they have received it, though it is not yet in hand.

decisions.choice: you received
decisions.reason: Later manuscripts change the past tense to a present or future, which reads more smoothly. The SBLGNT has the past tense. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: pray and ask: asking in prayer
decisions.reason: The two verbs describe one act from two sides: prayer that asks God for something.

decisions.choice: because of this: the promise rests on faith in God (11:22)
alternatives: a technique for getting anything one wants
decisions.reason: The saying grows out of "have faith in God" and is followed at once by the command to forgive (11:25).

decisions.choice: ask God
decisions.reason: Readable says to whom the request is made.

decisions.choice: "đã nhận được" at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision keeps the past tense, the answer counted as already given; "đã" says this plainly in Vietnamese.

source.text: καὶ ὅταν στήκετε προσευχόμενοι, ἀφίετε εἴ τι ἔχετε κατά τινος, ἵνα καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ὁ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς ἀφῇ ὑμῖν τὰ παραπτώματα ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: And whenever you stand praying, forgive if anything you have against anyone, so that also the Father of you who [is] in the heavens may forgive you the trespasses of you.

en.L: And whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone, so that your Father who [is] in the heavens may also forgive you your trespasses."
en.B: And whenever you stand up to pray, if you are holding anything against anyone, forgive them, so that your Father in heaven may forgive you your wrongdoings as well."
en.R: When you stand and pray, forgive anyone you have something against. Then your Father in heaven will also forgive you for the wrong things you have done."

vi.L: Và khi các con đứng cầu nguyện, hãy tha thứ, nếu các con có điều gì nghịch với ai, để Cha các con, Đấng ở trên các tầng trời, cũng tha thứ cho các con những vi phạm của các con."
vi.B: Và khi các con đứng cầu nguyện, nếu có điều gì phiền giận ai, hãy tha thứ cho người ấy, để Cha các con ở trên trời cũng tha thứ những lỗi lầm của các con."
vi.R: Khi các con đứng cầu nguyện, hãy tha thứ cho bất cứ ai mà các con đang giận. Rồi Cha các con ở trên trời cũng sẽ tha thứ những điều sai trái các con đã làm."

ko.L: 그리고 너희가 서서 기도할 때에, 누구에게 무슨 [원망할] 것이 있으면 용서하여라. 그래야 하늘에 계신 너희 아버지께서도 너희의 허물들을 용서해 주실 것이다."
ko.B: 너희가 서서 기도할 때에, 누구에게 맺힌 것이 있으면 그를 용서하여라. 그래야 하늘에 계신 너희 아버지께서도 너희의 허물을 용서해 주실 것이다."
ko.R: 너희가 서서 기도할 때, 누구에게 서운한 것이 있으면 그 사람을 용서해 주어라. 그러면 하늘에 계신 너희 아버지께서도 너희가 잘못한 일들을 용서해 주실 것이다."

es.L: Y cuando {{plural_you:estén|estéis}} de pie orando, {{plural_you:perdonen|perdonad}}, si {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} algo contra alguien, para que también {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Padre que [está] en los cielos {{plural_you:les|os}} perdone {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} transgresiones».
es.B: Y cuando {{plural_you:se pongan|os pongáis}} de pie para orar, si {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} algo contra alguien, {{plural_you:perdónenlo|perdonadlo}}, para que también {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Padre que está en el cielo {{plural_you:les|os}} perdone {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} faltas».
es.R: Cuando {{plural_you:estén|estéis}} de pie orando, {{plural_you:perdonen|perdonad}} a cualquiera contra quien {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} algo. Así {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Padre que está en el cielo también {{plural_you:les|os}} perdonará el mal que {{plural_you:han hecho|habéis hecho}}».

fr.L: Et quand vous vous tenez debout pour prier, pardonnez, si vous avez quelque chose contre quelqu’un, afin que votre Père qui [est] dans les cieux vous pardonne aussi vos fautes. »
fr.B: Et quand vous êtes debout pour prier, si vous avez quelque chose contre quelqu’un, pardonnez-lui, afin que votre Père qui est dans les cieux vous pardonne, lui aussi, vos fautes. »
fr.R: Quand vous êtes debout pour prier, pardonnez à ceux contre qui vous avez quelque chose. Alors votre Père qui est au ciel vous pardonnera aussi le mal que vous avez fait. »

sw.L: Na wakati wowote mnaposimama mkiomba, sameheni, kama mna jambo lolote dhidi ya mtu yeyote, ili Baba yenu aliye mbinguni pia awasamehe makosa yenu."
sw.B: Na kila mnaposimama kusali, ikiwa mna kinyongo na mtu yeyote, msameheni, ili Baba yenu wa mbinguni awasamehe nanyi makosa yenu."
sw.R: Mnaposimama kusali, msameheni mtu yeyote ambaye mna jambo dhidi yake. Ndipo Baba yenu aliye mbinguni atawasamehe ninyi pia mabaya mliyotenda."

pt.L: E, quando estiverem de pé orando, perdoem, se tiverem alguma coisa contra alguém, para que também o Pai de vocês que [está] nos céus lhes perdoe as transgressões de vocês."
pt.B: E, quando estiverem de pé para orar, se tiverem alguma coisa contra alguém, perdoem, para que o Pai de vocês, que está no céu, também perdoe as ofensas de vocês."
pt.R: Quando vocês ficarem de pé para orar, perdoem qualquer pessoa contra quem tiverem alguma queixa. Então o Pai de vocês, que está no céu, também vai perdoar as coisas erradas que vocês fizeram."

am.L: ስትጸልዩም በቆማችሁ ጊዜ፣ በማንም ላይ አንዳች ቢኖራችሁ ይቅር በሉ፤ በሰማያት ያለው አባታችሁ ደግሞ በደላችሁን ይቅር እንዲላችሁ።»
am.B: ለመጸለይ በቆማችሁ ጊዜ በማንም ላይ ቅሬታ ቢኖራችሁ ይቅር በሉት፤ ይኸውም በሰማይ ያለው አባታችሁ ደግሞ በደላችሁን ይቅር እንዲላችሁ ነው።»
am.R: ቆማችሁ ስትጸልዩ ቅሬታ ያላችሁበትን ሰው ሁሉ ይቅር በሉ። ያን ጊዜ በሰማይ ያለው አባታችሁ ደግሞ ያደረጋችሁትን ጥፋት ይቅር ይላችኋል።»

ru.L: И когда стоите на молитве, прощайте, если что-нибудь имеете против кого-нибудь, чтобы и Отец ваш, [который] на небесах, простил вам ваши прегрешения.»
ru.B: И когда вы встаёте молиться, простите, если у вас что-то есть против кого-нибудь, чтобы и ваш Небесный Отец простил вам ваши проступки.»
ru.R: Когда вы стоите и молитесь, простите каждого, на кого вы держите обиду. Тогда и ваш Отец на небесах простит вам то плохое, что вы сделали.»

hi.L: और जब कभी तुम खड़े होकर प्रार्थना करते हो, तो यदि तुम्हारे मन में किसी के विरुद्ध कुछ हो, तो क्षमा करो, ताकि तुम्हारे पिता भी, जो स्वर्ग में हैं, तुम्हारे अपराध क्षमा करें।"
hi.B: और जब भी तुम प्रार्थना करने खड़े हो, तो यदि तुम्हारे मन में किसी के विरुद्ध कुछ है, तो उसे क्षमा कर दो, ताकि तुम्हारे स्वर्गीय पिता भी तुम्हारे अपराध क्षमा करें।"
hi.R: जब तुम खड़े होकर प्रार्थना करो, तो जिससे भी तुम नाराज़ हो, उसे माफ़ कर दो। तब स्वर्ग में रहनेवाले तुम्हारे पिता भी तुम्हारी ग़लतियाँ माफ़ करेंगे।"

uk.L: І коли стоїте, молячись, прощайте, якщо маєте щось проти когось, щоб і ваш Отець, який на небесах, простив вам ваші провини.»
uk.B: І коли ви стаєте до молитви, а маєте щось проти когось, простіть йому, щоб і ваш Отець небесний простив вам ваші провини.»
uk.R: Коли ви стоїте й молитеся, простіть кожному, на кого маєте образу. Тоді й ваш Отець на небі простить вам те погане, що ви зробили.»

ja.L: また、立って祈るときにはいつも、だれかに対して何か[恨みを]持っているなら、赦しなさい。天におられるあなたがたの父も、あなたがたの罪過を赦してくださるためである。」
ja.B: また、立って祈るとき、だれかに対して何か恨みに思うことがあるなら、その人を赦しなさい。そうすれば、天におられるあなたがたの父も、あなたがたの過ちを赦してくださる。」
ja.R: 立って祈るときには、だれかに対して何か恨みがあるなら、その人をゆるしなさい。そうすれば、天におられるあなたたちの父も、あなたたちがした悪いことをゆるしてくださる。」

decisions.choice: stand praying: standing was a usual posture for prayer
decisions.reason: People commonly stood to pray (1 Samuel 1:26; Luke 18:11-13).

decisions.choice: so that your Father may forgive you: forgiving others and being forgiven belong together
decisions.reason: Those who come to God asking forgiveness must forgive others, as in the prayer Jesus taught (Matthew 6:12, 14-15).

decisions.choice: trespasses: false steps, wrongs done
decisions.reason: The word means a false step or offense, a wrong done against God or others.

decisions.choice: your Father who is in the heavens: God, the Father of those who pray
decisions.reason: The plural "heavens" follows Hebrew idiom. This is the only place in Mark where Jesus says "your Father".

decisions.choice: the SBLGNT has no verse 26
alternatives: add verse 26: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father who is in the heavens forgive your trespasses
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add these words here. The earliest manuscripts lack them, and they are almost the same as Matthew 6:15, from which scribes likely copied them to round out the saying. Verse 26 is skipped in the numbering for this reason. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: heaven; wrongdoings (B), wrong things you have done (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the usual singular "heaven" and plain words for wrongs. Literal keeps the plural and the older word.

decisions.choice: "vi phạm" (L); "lỗi lầm" (B); "những điều sai trái các con đã làm" (R) for trespasses
decisions.reason: Literal uses "vi phạm", the word the Vietnamese Colossians uses for the same Greek word (2:13); Balanced and Readable use plainer words for wrongs done. "Tội lỗi" is kept for the word for sin.

decisions.choice: "Cha các con", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: "Cha" is a noun, always capitalised, and takes no setting (style guide section 7).

decisions.choice: "허물" (L, B); "잘못한 일들" (R) for paraptomata
decisions.reason: "허물" is a wrong step or fault, close to the Greek picture of a false step, and keeps "죄" for hamartia; Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: [원망할] (to hold against)
decisions.reason: Korean cannot say "have something against someone" word for word; Literal brackets the verb it needs.

decisions.choice: el cielo; faltas (B), el mal que han hecho (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: plain words for "the heavens" and for the trespasses (meaning decisions m3, m4); Literal keeps "los cielos" and "transgresiones".

decisions.choice: vos fautes (L, B); le mal que vous avez fait (R)
decisions.reason: The word is a false step, a wrong done (meaning decision). "Offenses" is the traditional word but now usually means an insult; "péchés" would merge it with the ordinary word for sin. "Fautes" says a wrong done, plainly.

decisions.choice: as transgressões (L); as ofensas (B); as coisas erradas que vocês fizeram (R)
decisions.reason: The word means a false step, a wrong done (m3), not the general word for sin, so no level says "pecados". Literal keeps the older "transgressões", as the English keeps "trespasses"; Balanced says "ofensas", the word Brazilians use for wrongs done against others; Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: "በሰማያት" (L), "በሰማይ" (B, R); "በደል" (trespasses) (L, B), "ያደረጋችሁት ጥፋት" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek has the plural heavens, kept at Literal; Balanced and Readable use the ordinary singular. "በደል" is a wrong done against someone, close to the Greek false step, and keeps it apart from "ኃጢአት" (sin).

decisions.choice: "स्वर्ग में" with the singular
decisions.reason: Hindi does not pluralise स्वर्ग in this phrase, so Literal keeps the singular, as for "स्वर्ग का राज्य" in Matthew; God the Father takes the honorific ("हैं", "करें").

decisions.choice: "罪過" (L); "過ち" (B); "悪いこと" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is a false step, a wrong done (m3). Literal keeps an older, weightier word; Balanced and Readable use plain words, as the English does. Japanese "天" has no plural, so the Greek "heavens" reads as "天" at every level.

decisions.choice: "天におられる", "赦してくださる" for the Father in Jesus' words
decisions.reason: When Jesus speaks of God's acts, Japanese uses light respect forms, as in John ("与えてくださった"); Jesus' own words to the disciples stay plain.

source.text: Καὶ ἔρχονται πάλιν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα.

records.literal_gloss: And they come again to Jerusalem.

en.L: And they come again to Jerusalem.
en.B: They came back into Jerusalem once more.
en.R: Jesus and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} disciples went back to Jerusalem again.

vi.L: Và họ lại đến Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Họ trở lại Giê-ru-sa-lem một lần nữa.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu và các môn đồ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 다시 예루살렘으로 온다.
ko.B: 그들은 다시 예루살렘으로 들어갔다.
ko.R: 예수와 제자들은 또다시 예루살렘으로 갔다.

es.L: Y vienen de nuevo a Jerusalén.
es.B: Volvieron una vez más a Jerusalén.
es.R: Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} discípulos regresaron otra vez a Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et ils viennent de nouveau à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Ils revinrent encore une fois à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} disciples sont retournés à Jérusalem.

sw.L: Na wanakuja tena Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Wakaingia tena Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Yesu na wanafunzi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walirudi tena Yerusalemu.

pt.L: E chegam de novo a Jerusalém.
pt.B: Eles voltaram mais uma vez a Jerusalém.
pt.R: Jesus e os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} discípulos voltaram outra vez a Jerusalém.

am.L: ደግሞም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይመጣሉ።
am.B: እንደ ገናም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ።
am.R: ኢየሱስና ደቀ መዛሙርቱ እንደ ገና ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ።

ru.L: И приходят снова в Иерусалим.
ru.B: Они снова пришли в Иерусалим.
ru.R: Иисус и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ученики снова вернулись в Иерусалим.

hi.L: और वे फिर यरूशलेम में आते हैं।
hi.B: वे एक बार फिर यरूशलेम में आए।
hi.R: यीशु और उनके चेले फिर से यरूशलेम गए।

uk.L: І приходять знову до Єрусалима.
uk.B: Вони знову повернулися до Єрусалима.
uk.R: Ісус і {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} учні знову повернулися до Єрусалима.

ja.L: そして彼らは再びエルサレムに来る。
ja.B: 一行はまたエルサレムに来た。
ja.R: イエスと弟子たちは、またエルサレムに行きました。

decisions.choice: they come: present tense in a story about the past
decisions.reason: As before, Mark tells the past in the present; the sense is past.

decisions.choice: again: the third day running that Jesus enters the city
alternatives: a return after a long time
decisions.reason: Jesus came into the city in 11:11 and 11:15, and now again.

decisions.choice: Jesus and his disciples
decisions.reason: Readable says who came.

source.text: καὶ ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ περιπατοῦντος αὐτοῦ ἔρχονται πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι καὶ ἔλεγον αὐτῷ· Ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιεῖς;

records.literal_gloss: And in the temple walking him come to him the chief priests and the scribes and the elders, \v 28 and they were saying to him, By what authority these things are you doing?

en.L: And as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is walking in the temple, the chief priests and the scribes and the elders come to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \v 28 and were saying to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, "By what authority are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} doing these things?
en.B: As {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was walking in the temple courts, the chief priests, the scribes and the elders came up to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \v 28 and demanded, "What authority do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have for doing these things?
en.R: Jesus was walking in the temple area. The leading priests, the teachers of God's law, and the elders came to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 28 They said, "What right do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have to do these things?

vi.L: Và khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang đi trong đền thờ, các thầy tế lễ cả, các thầy thông giáo và các trưởng lão đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \v 28 và nói với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Ông làm những việc này bởi thẩm quyền nào?
vi.B: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang đi trong sân đền thờ, các thầy tế lễ cả, các thầy thông giáo và các trưởng lão đến gặp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \v 28 và chất vấn: "Ông lấy thẩm quyền nào mà làm những việc này?
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu đang đi trong sân đền thờ. Các thầy tế lễ cả, các thầy dạy luật và các trưởng lão đến gặp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 28 Họ hỏi: "Ông có quyền gì mà làm những việc này?

ko.L: 그리고 그분이 성전 안에서 거닐고 계실 때에, 대제사장들과 율법학자들과 장로들이 그분께 온다. \v 28 그리고 그분께 말하고 있었다. "당신은 무슨 권한으로 이런 일들을 합니까?
ko.B: 예수께서 성전 뜰을 거닐고 계실 때에, 대제사장들과 율법학자들과 장로들이 예수께 다가와서 \v 28 따져 물었다. "당신은 무슨 권한으로 이런 일들을 합니까?
ko.R: 예수께서 성전 뜰을 거닐고 계셨다. 그때 대제사장들과 율법을 가르치는 선생들과 장로들이 예수께 왔다. \v 28 그들이 말했다. "당신이 무슨 권리로 이런 일들을 합니까?

es.L: Y mientras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} anda por el templo, vienen a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los principales sacerdotes y los escribas y los ancianos \v 28 y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} decían: «¿Con qué autoridad haces estas cosas?
es.B: Mientras caminaba por los atrios del templo, se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} acercaron los jefes de los sacerdotes, los escribas y los ancianos \v 28 y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} exigieron: «¿Con qué autoridad haces estas cosas?
es.R: Jesús estaba caminando por el patio del templo. Los jefes de los sacerdotes, los maestros de la ley y los ancianos se acercaron a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \v 28 Le dijeron: «¿Con qué derecho haces estas cosas?

fr.L: Et comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} marche dans le temple, les chefs des prêtres et les scribes et les anciens viennent à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} \v 28 et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} disaient : « Par quelle autorité fais-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ces choses ?
fr.B: Comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} marchait dans la cour du temple, les chefs des prêtres, les scribes et les anciens vinrent {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} trouver \v 28 et {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demandèrent : « Par quelle autorité fais-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ces choses ?
fr.R: Jésus marchait dans la cour du temple. Les chefs des prêtres, les spécialistes de la Loi et les anciens sont venus {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} trouver. \v 28 Ils {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ont dit : « De quel droit fais-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ces choses ?

sw.L: Na alipokuwa akitembea hekaluni, wakuu wa makuhani na waandishi na wazee wanakuja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} \v 28 nao walikuwa wakimwambia, "Kwa mamlaka gani unafanya mambo haya?
sw.B: Alipokuwa akitembea katika nyua za hekalu, wakuu wa makuhani, waandishi na wazee walimwendea \v 28 wakamwuliza kwa ukali, "Una mamlaka gani ya kufanya mambo haya?
sw.R: Yesu alikuwa akitembea katika eneo la hekalu. Viongozi wa makuhani, walimu wa sheria na wazee wakamjia. \v 28 Wakamwuliza, "Umepata wapi ruhusa ya kufanya mambo haya?

pt.L: E, enquanto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} anda pelo templo, vêm até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os chefes dos sacerdotes, e os escribas, e os anciãos \v 28 e {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} diziam: "Com que autoridade fazes estas coisas?
pt.B: Enquanto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} andava pelos pátios do templo, os chefes dos sacerdotes, os escribas e os anciãos se aproximaram {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} \v 28 e exigiram: "Que autoridade tens para fazer estas coisas?
pt.R: Jesus estava andando pela área do templo. Os chefes dos sacerdotes, os mestres da Lei e os anciãos vieram até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. \v 28 Eles perguntaram: "Que direito tens de fazer estas coisas?

am.L: እርሱም በቤተ መቅደስ ሲመላለስ የካህናት አለቆችና ጸሐፍት ሽማግሌዎችም ወደ እርሱ ይመጣሉ፤ \v 28 እንዲህም ይሉት ነበር፦ «በምን ሥልጣን እነዚህን ታደርጋለህ?
am.B: በቤተ መቅደሱ አደባባይ ሲመላለስ የካህናት አለቆች፣ የሕግ መምህራንና ሽማግሌዎች ወደ እርሱ ቀረቡ፤ \v 28 እንዲህም ብለው ጠየቁት፦ «እነዚህን ነገሮች የምታደርገው በምን ሥልጣን ነው?
am.R: ኢየሱስ በቤተ መቅደሱ አደባባይ ይመላለስ ነበር። የካህናት አለቆች፣ የሕግ መምህራንና ሽማግሌዎች ወደ እርሱ መጡ። \v 28 እንዲህም አሉት፦ «እነዚህን ነገሮች ለማድረግ ምን ሥልጣን አለህ?

ru.L: И когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} ходит по Храму, приходят к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}} старшие священники, и книжники, и старейшины \v 28 и говорили {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}: «Какой властью {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} это делаешь?
ru.B: Когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} ходил по двору Храма, к {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}} подошли старшие священники, учители Закона и старейшины \v 28 и потребовали ответа: «Какой властью {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} это делаешь?
ru.R: Иисус ходил по двору Храма. К {{deity_pronoun:нему|Нему}} подошли старшие священники, учители Закона и старейшины. \v 28 Они спросили: «Какое право {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} имеешь это делать?

hi.L: और जब वे मन्दिर में टहल रहे होते हैं, तो प्रधान याजक और शास्त्री और पुरनिए उनके पास आते हैं \v 28 और उनसे कहने लगे, "आप ये काम किस अधिकार से कर रहे हैं?
hi.B: जब वे मन्दिर के आँगन में टहल रहे थे, तो प्रधान याजक, व्यवस्था के शिक्षक और बुज़ुर्ग अगुवे उनके पास आए \v 28 और पूछने लगे, "आप किस अधिकार से ये काम कर रहे हैं?
hi.R: यीशु मन्दिर के आँगन में टहल रहे थे। तब प्रधान याजक, व्यवस्था के शिक्षक और बुज़ुर्ग अगुवे उनके पास आए। \v 28 उन्होंने कहा, "आपको ये काम करने का क्या हक़ है?

uk.L: І коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} ходить у храмі, приходять до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} старші священники, і книжники, і старійшини, \v 28 і казали {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}: «Якою владою {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} це робиш?
uk.B: Коли {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} ходив храмом, до {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} підійшли старші священники, учителі Закону й старійшини \v 28 і зажадали: «Яку владу {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} маєш, щоб це робити?
uk.R: Ісус ходив по території храму. До {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} підійшли старші священники, учителі Закону й старійшини. \v 28 Вони сказали: «Яке право {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} маєш таке робити?

ja.L: そして[イエスが]神殿の中を歩いておられると、祭司長たちと律法学者たちと長老たちがイエスのところに来る。\v 28 そしてイエスに言っていた。「何の権威によって、これらのことをしているのか？
ja.B: イエスが神殿の境内を歩いておられると、祭司長たち、律法学者たち、長老たちがやって来て、\v 28 詰め寄った。「何の権威があって、こんなことをしているのか？
ja.R: イエスは神殿の境内を歩いておられました。そこへ、祭司長たちと律法の先生たちと長老たちがやって来ました。\v 28 そして言いました。「どんな権利があって、こんなことをしているのか？

decisions.choice: the chief priests, the scribes and the elders: the groups that made up the council of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Together they formed the Sanhedrin, the ruling council (14:53, 15:1). Jesus had named these three as those who would reject him (8:31).

decisions.choice: authority: the right to act, given by someone with power to give it
decisions.reason: The word means authority or right. Mark has said that Jesus taught with authority (1:22, 1:27) and has authority to forgive sins (2:10).

decisions.choice: these things: above all the action in the temple, and perhaps his teaching there
decisions.reason: The question comes the day after Jesus drove out the traders. Mark does not limit "these things".

decisions.choice: What right
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plain word for authority. It also says "leading priests" and "teachers of God's law", as before.

decisions.choice: "ông" for the leaders addressing Jesus, with no deity_pronoun span (also 11:28, 11:31)
decisions.reason: "Ông" is the polite but distant address of officials who challenge him, as the temple authorities speak in the Vietnamese John (2:18); "Thầy" would grant a respect they withhold. It is a noun of address and takes no setting.

decisions.choice: "các trưởng lão" for the elders; "thẩm quyền" (L, B), "quyền" (R) for authority
decisions.reason: "Trưởng lão" is the established Protestant word for the elders; "thẩm quyền" is the right to act given by someone with power, as the meaning decision says, and Readable uses the everyday "quyền" (right).

decisions.choice: The leaders speak to Jesus in 합쇼체 but with "당신" and no honorific -시-, through 11:33
decisions.reason: They challenge him as officials questioning a man they do not accept; formal endings with "당신" keep the courtesy of the debate and its coldness. Contrast the flattery of 12:14, which honours him. A reviewer may prefer the full honorific (style guide, section 4).

decisions.choice: "권한" (L, B); "권리" (R) for exousia
decisions.reason: "권한" is authority given by someone, as in the Korean Mark 3:15 and John 1:12; Readable's "권리" (right) matches the English Readable. "권세" is the older church word.

decisions.choice: derecho
decisions.reason: As in English: Readable says "right" for authority (meaning decision m2), here and in 11:28-33.

decisions.choice: De quel droit (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable: the word means the right to act, given by someone with power to give it (meaning decision), and "de quel droit" says that in everyday French.

decisions.choice: "mamlaka" (L, B); "ruhusa" (R)
decisions.reason: "Mamlaka" is authority given by someone with power to give it, the sense in the meaning note, and the word John 1:12 uses. Readable says "ruhusa" (permission) for the English "right"; "haki" is not used, because in this translation it is kept for righteousness.

decisions.choice: tu (fazes, tens, te)
decisions.reason: The leaders speak to Jesus, so they use "tu", as everyone does who addresses him (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4); their hostility shows in the demand itself, as in Matthew 21:23.

decisions.choice: "ሥልጣን" (authority) at Readable too
decisions.reason: "ሥልጣን" is the everyday word for authority given by someone, the point of the question (m2), and "መብት" would sound like a legal right of his own; Matthew 21:23 has "ሥልጣን" at every level. The leaders say "አንተ" to Jesus, as everyone does.

decisions.choice: "власть" (L, B); "право" (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as Matthew 21:23: Readable says "право" for the right to act (also 11:28-29, 11:33).

decisions.choice: "पुरनिए" (L); "बुज़ुर्ग अगुवे" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's key term: the elders were leaders of the people, not only old men. The leaders say "आप" to Jesus, as everyone does (style guide section 4).

decisions.choice: "हक़" (R); "अधिकार" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Readable uses the everyday word for the right to act, as the English Readable does and as in Matthew 21:23-27, through 11:33.

decisions.choice: "влада" (L, B); "право" (R), for exousia in 11:28-33
decisions.reason: Exousia is the right to act given by someone who can give it; "влада" is the usual word, Readable says plainly that they ask who gave him the right.

decisions.choice: "権威" (L, B); "権利" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the right to act, given by one who has power to give it (m2). "権威" is the usual word in Mark (1:22; 2:10); Readable says "right", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: the leaders speak to Jesus plainly ("しているのか？")
decisions.reason: The council's members come to challenge him, not to ask a favour, so they speak in the plain style, as rulers do in Japanese Open Word Bible narrative. Jesus answers plainly, with authority.

source.text: ἢ τίς σοι ἔδωκεν τὴν ἐξουσίαν ταύτην ἵνα ταῦτα ποιῇς;

records.literal_gloss: Or who to you gave the authority this that these things you should do?

en.L: Or who gave {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} this authority, that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} should do these things?"
en.B: Or who is it that gave {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} this authority to do them?"
en.R: Who gave {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} the right to do them?"

vi.L: Hay ai đã ban cho ông thẩm quyền này để ông làm những việc ấy?"
vi.B: Hay ai đã ban cho ông thẩm quyền này để làm những việc ấy?"
vi.R: Ai đã cho ông quyền làm những việc ấy?"

ko.L: 또는 누가 당신에게 이런 일들을 하라고 이 권한을 주었습니까?"
ko.B: 누가 당신에게 이런 일을 할 권한을 주었습니까?"
ko.R: 누가 당신에게 이런 일을 해도 된다고 했습니까?"

es.L: ¿O quién {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dio esta autoridad para que hagas estas cosas?».
es.B: ¿O quién {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ha dado autoridad para hacerlas?».
es.R: ¿Quién {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dio el derecho de hacerlas?».

fr.L: Ou qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}a donné cette autorité, pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fasses ces choses ? »
fr.B: Ou bien qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}a donné cette autorité pour les faire ? »
fr.R: Qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}a donné le droit de les faire ? »

sw.L: Au ni nani aliyekupa mamlaka haya ili ufanye mambo haya?"
sw.B: Au ni nani aliyekupa mamlaka hayo ya kuyafanya?"
sw.R: Ni nani aliyekupa ruhusa ya kuyafanya?"

pt.L: Ou quem {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} deu esta autoridade, para que faças estas coisas?"
pt.B: Ou quem foi que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} deu essa autoridade para fazê-las?"
pt.R: Quem {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} deu o direito de fazer isso?"

am.L: ወይስ እነዚህን ታደርግ ዘንድ ይህን ሥልጣን ማን ሰጠህ?»
am.B: ወይስ እነዚህን ለማድረግ ይህን ሥልጣን የሰጠህ ማን ነው?»
am.R: እነዚህን ለማድረግ ሥልጣን የሰጠህ ማን ነው?»

ru.L: Или кто дал {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} эту власть, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} это делал?»
ru.B: Или кто дал {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} власть так поступать?»
ru.R: Кто дал {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} право так поступать?»

hi.L: या आपको यह अधिकार किसने दिया कि आप ये काम करें?"
hi.B: या किसने आपको यह अधिकार दिया है कि आप ये काम करें?"
hi.R: किसने आपको ये काम करने का हक़ दिया?"

uk.L: Або хто дав {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} цю владу, щоб {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} це робив?»
uk.B: Або хто дав {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} владу це робити?»
uk.R: Хто дав {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} право це робити?»

ja.L: あるいは、これらのことをするようにと、だれがあなたにこの権威を与えたのか？」
ja.B: それとも、だれがあなたにそうする権威を与えたのか？」
ja.R: だれが、あなたにそうする権利を与えたのか？」

decisions.choice: or who gave you: the second question asks for the source
alternatives: a separate question on another subject
decisions.reason: The second question narrows the first: who stands behind you? The leaders had not given him authority, and they did not accept that God had.

decisions.choice: authority: the same word as in the first question
decisions.reason: The repeated word ties the questions together.

decisions.choice: to do them
alternatives: that you should do these things
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable avoid repeating "these things" a third time.

source.text: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἐπερωτήσω ὑμᾶς ἕνα λόγον, καὶ ἀποκρίθητέ μοι, καὶ ἐρῶ ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ·

records.literal_gloss: And Jesus said to them, I will ask you one word, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority these things I do.

en.L: And Jesus said to them, "I will ask you one question; answer {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
en.B: Jesus said to them, "I will put one question to you. Answer {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and then I will tell you what authority I have for doing these things.
en.R: Jesus answered, "Let {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ask you one question. If you give {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} an answer, I will tell you who gave {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} the right to do these things.

vi.L: Và Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Ta sẽ hỏi các người một câu; hãy trả lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, rồi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nói cho các người biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm những việc này bởi thẩm quyền nào.
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Ta sẽ hỏi các người một câu. Hãy trả lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, rồi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho các người biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lấy thẩm quyền nào mà làm những việc này.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu trả lời: "Ta hỏi các người một câu. Nếu các người trả lời được, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho các người biết ai đã cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} quyền làm những việc này.

ko.L: 그러자 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "내가 너희에게 한 가지 말을 묻겠다. 그리고 나에게 대답하여라. 그러면 내가 무슨 권한으로 이런 일들을 하는지 너희에게 말하겠다.
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "나도 너희에게 한 가지 묻겠다. 나에게 대답해 보아라. 그러면 내가 무슨 권한으로 이런 일들을 하는지 너희에게 말해 주겠다.
ko.R: 예수께서 대답하셨다. "나도 너희에게 한 가지 묻겠다. 너희가 대답하면, 누가 나에게 이런 일을 할 권리를 주었는지 말해 주겠다.

es.L: Y Jesús les dijo: «{{plural_you:Les|Os}} preguntaré una sola cosa; {{plural_you:respóndanme|respondedme}}, y {{plural_you:les|os}} diré con qué autoridad hago estas cosas.
es.B: Jesús les dijo: «Voy a hacer{{plural_you:les|os}} una pregunta. {{plural_you:Respóndanme|Respondedme}}, y entonces {{plural_you:les|os}} diré con qué autoridad hago estas cosas.
es.R: Jesús les respondió: «{{plural_you:Permítanme|Permitidme}} hacer{{plural_you:les|os}} una pregunta. Si {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:responden|respondéis}}, {{plural_you:les|os}} diré quién {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dio el derecho de hacer estas cosas.

fr.L: Et Jésus leur dit : « Je vous demanderai une seule chose ; répondez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et je vous dirai par quelle autorité je fais ces choses.

fr.R: Jésus a répondu : « Je vais vous poser une question. Si vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} répondez, je vous dirai qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a donné le droit de faire ces choses.

ru.L: А Иисус сказал им: «Я спрошу вас об одном слове, и ответьте {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} скажу вам, какой властью это делаю.
ru.B: Иисус сказал им: «Я задам вам один вопрос. Ответьте {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}, и тогда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} скажу вам, какой властью {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} это делаю.
ru.R: Иисус ответил: «Позвольте {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} задать вам один вопрос. Если вы {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} ответите, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} скажу вам, кто дал {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} право это делать.

hi.L: और यीशु ने उनसे कहा, "मैं तुमसे एक बात पूछूँगा; मुझे उत्तर दो, और मैं तुम्हें बताऊँगा कि मैं ये काम किस अधिकार से करता हूँ।

hi.R: यीशु ने जवाब दिया, "मुझे तुमसे एक सवाल पूछने दो। अगर तुम मुझे उसका जवाब दोगे, तो मैं तुम्हें बताऊँगा कि मुझे ये काम करने का हक़ किसने दिया।

ja.L: そこでイエスは彼らに言われた。「わたしはあなたがたに一つのことを尋ねよう。そしてわたしに答えなさい。そうすれば、何の権威によってこれらのことをするのか、あなたがたに言おう。
ja.B: イエスは彼らに言われた。「一つ、あなたがたに尋ねよう。それに答えなさい。そうすれば、何の権威でこのようなことをしているのか、あなたがたに話そう。
ja.R: イエスはお答えになりました。「では、一つ聞こう。もし答えたら、だれがわたしにこういうことをする権利を与えたのか、あなたたちに教えよう。

decisions.choice: word: here a question or matter
decisions.reason: The noun often means a matter or saying. Here it is the question Jesus is about to ask.

decisions.choice: answering a question with a question: a common form of debate among teachers
decisions.reason: Teachers of the law often replied with a counter-question. Jesus' question bears directly on theirs.

decisions.choice: answer me, and I will tell you: if you answer, I will tell
decisions.reason: A command followed by a promise works as a condition.

decisions.choice: If you give me an answer, I will tell you
alternatives: answer me, and I will tell you
decisions.reason: Readable writes the condition as a plain "if".

decisions.choice: "các người" for Jesus addressing the leaders (11:29-33)
decisions.reason: The style guide's form for Jesus speaking to opponents and officials, as in the Vietnamese John (2:19); it is firm without being rude.

decisions.choice: "나도" (I too)
decisions.reason: Korean marks a question answered with a question by "나도"; it adds no meaning beyond the exchange the meaning decision describes, so Literal keeps the plain "내가".

decisions.choice: from heaven: from God
decisions.reason: "Heaven" was a reverent way of speaking of God without naming him.

decisions.choice: the baptism of John: John's whole work of baptizing and the message that went with it
decisions.reason: John called people to be baptized as a sign of repentance (1:4-5) and pointed to the one coming after him (1:7-8). Jesus himself was baptized by John (1:9).

decisions.choice: men: human beings, people in general
decisions.reason: The word is used of humans as opposed to God.

decisions.choice: God; only
decisions.reason: Readable says what "heaven" stands for. "Only" brings out the contrast between a human and a divine source.

decisions.choice: "phép báp-têm của Giăng"
decisions.reason: Settled for the whole Bible: Vietnamese follows the Protestant tradition ("báp-têm", "Giăng"); the Catholic forms are given as the alternative.

decisions.choice: No gender span: "사람들", "사람"
alternatives: a gender setting span, as in the English
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" means human beings, men and women, so there is no second form for the setting to give.

decisions.choice: {{gender:des humains|des hommes}}
decisions.reason: The word means human beings in general (meaning decision). French "des hommes" is read as generic less and less, so the default says "des humains", with the traditional wording as the alternative; the same span is used in 11:32.

decisions.choice: "人から" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs a gender span for people/men (m3); Japanese "人" already means human beings in general, so no span is needed here or in 11:32.

am.L: እርስ በርሳቸውም እንዲህ እያሉ ይመካከሩ ነበር፦ «ምን እንበል?
am.B: እርስ በርሳቸውም እንዲህ ተመካከሩ፦ «ምን ብለን እንመልስ?
am.R: እርስ በርሳቸው ተከራከሩ። እንዲህም አሉ፦ «ምን እንበል?

ru.L: И они рассуждали между собой, говоря: «Что нам сказать?
ru.B: Они стали обсуждать это между собой: «Что нам сказать?
ru.R: Они заспорили об этом друг с другом. Они говорили: «Что нам сказать?

hi.L: और वे आपस में विचार करते हुए कहने लगे, "हम क्या कहें?
hi.B: वे आपस में सोच-विचार करने लगे: "हम क्या कहें?
hi.R: वे आपस में इस पर बहस करने लगे। उन्होंने कहा, "हम क्या कहें?

uk.L: І вони міркували між собою, кажучи: «Що скажемо?
uk.B: Вони радилися між собою: «Що нам сказати?
uk.R: Вони сперечалися про це між собою. Вони казали: «Що нам сказати?

ja.L: そして彼らは互いに論じ合って言っていた。「何と言おうか？
ja.B: 彼らは互いに相談した。「何と答えたらよいだろう？
ja.R: 彼らは、そのことで言い合いました。そして言いました。「何と言ったらいいだろう？

decisions.choice: What should we say?
alternatives: omit the question: they reasoned, saying, If we say ...
decisions.reason: Most manuscripts do not have this short question, and the sentence goes straight on to "If we say". The SBLGNT includes it with a smaller number of manuscripts. Reviewers should check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: they were reasoning: they discussed it back and forth
decisions.reason: The tense pictures a discussion that went on for a time.

decisions.choice: argued about it
decisions.reason: Readable uses an everyday word for their discussion.

source.text: ἐὰν εἴπωμεν· Ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, ἐρεῖ· Διὰ τί οὖν οὐκ ἐπιστεύσατε αὐτῷ;

records.literal_gloss: If we say, From heaven, he will say, Why then not did you believe him?

en.L: If we say, 'From heaven,' {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will say, 'Why then did you not believe him?'
en.B: If we say, 'From heaven,' {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will reply, 'Then why did you not believe him?'
en.R: If we say, 'God sent him,' Jesus will ask us, 'Then why did you not believe John?'

vi.L: Nếu chúng ta nói: 'Từ trời,' thì ông ta sẽ nói: 'Vậy sao các người không tin ông ấy?'
vi.B: Nếu chúng ta nói: 'Từ trời,' ông ta sẽ bảo: 'Thế thì tại sao các người không tin ông ấy?'
vi.R: Nếu chúng ta nói: 'Đức Chúa Trời đã sai ông ấy,' thì ông ta sẽ hỏi chúng ta: 'Vậy sao các người không tin Giăng?'

ko.L: 만일 우리가 '하늘로부터'라고 말하면, 그는 '그러면 왜 너희는 그를 믿지 않았느냐?' 하고 말할 것이다.
ko.B: '하늘에서 온 것이다' 하면, 그는 '그러면 왜 너희는 요한을 믿지 않았느냐?' 하고 말할 것이다.
ko.R: '하나님께서 요한을 보내셨다'라고 하면, 예수가 '그러면 너희는 왜 요한을 믿지 않았느냐?' 하고 물을 것이다.

es.L: Si decimos: “Del cielo”, dirá: “¿Por qué, pues, no le {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}?”.
es.B: Si decimos: “Del cielo”, nos responderá: “Entonces, ¿por qué no le {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}?”.
es.R: Si decimos: “Dios lo envió”, Jesús nos preguntará: “Entonces, ¿por qué no le {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}} a Juan?”.

fr.L: Si nous disons : “Du ciel”, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dira : “Pourquoi donc ne l’avez-vous pas cru ?”
fr.B: Si nous disons : “Du ciel”, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} répondra : “Alors pourquoi ne l’avez-vous pas cru ?”
fr.R: Si nous disons : “Dieu l’a envoyé”, Jésus va nous demander : “Alors pourquoi n’avez-vous pas cru Jean ?”

sw.L: Tukisema, 'Kutoka mbinguni,' atasema, 'Basi kwa nini hamkumwamini?'
sw.B: Tukisema, 'Ulitoka mbinguni,' atatujibu, 'Basi mbona hamkumwamini?'
sw.R: Tukisema, 'Mungu ndiye aliyemtuma,' Yesu atatuuliza, 'Basi kwa nini hamkumwamini Yohana?'

pt.L: Se dissermos: 'Do céu', {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} dirá: 'Por que então vocês não creram nele?'
pt.B: Se dissermos: 'Do céu', {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai responder: 'Então por que vocês não creram nele?'
pt.R: Se dissermos: 'Deus o enviou', Jesus vai nos perguntar: 'Então por que vocês não acreditaram em João?'

am.L: “ከሰማይ” ብንል “ታዲያ ለምን አላመናችሁትም?” ይላል።
am.B: “ከሰማይ ነው” ብንል “ታዲያ ለምን አላመናችሁትም?” ብሎ ይመልስልናል።
am.R: “እግዚአብሔር ልኮታል” ብንል ኢየሱስ “ታዲያ ዮሐንስን ለምን አላመናችሁትም?” ብሎ ይጠይቀናል።

ru.L: Если скажем: “С неба”, — {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} скажет: “Почему же вы не поверили ему?”
ru.B: Если мы скажем: “С небес”, — {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} ответит: “Почему же тогда вы ему не поверили?”
ru.R: Если мы скажем: “Его послал Бог”, — Иисус спросит нас: “Почему же тогда вы не поверили Иоанну?”

hi.L: यदि हम कहें, 'स्वर्ग से,' तो वह कहेगा, 'तो फिर तुमने उस पर विश्वास क्यों नहीं किया?'
hi.B: यदि हम कहें, 'स्वर्ग की ओर से,' तो वह कहेगा, 'फिर तुमने उस पर विश्वास क्यों नहीं किया?'
hi.R: अगर हम कहें, 'परमेश्वर ने उसे भेजा था,' तो यीशु हमसे पूछेगा, 'तो फिर तुमने यूहन्ना पर विश्वास क्यों नहीं किया?'

uk.L: Якщо скажемо: “З неба”, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} скаже: “Чому ж ви не повірили йому?”
uk.B: Якщо скажемо: “З неба”, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} відповість: “Тоді чому ви не повірили йому?”
uk.R: Якщо ми скажемо: “Його послав Бог”, Ісус запитає нас: “Тоді чому ви не повірили Іванові?”

ja.L: もし『天から』と言えば、彼は『では、なぜ彼を信じなかったのか？』と言うだろう。
ja.B: もし『天から』と言えば、彼は『では、なぜヨハネを信じなかったのか？』と言うだろう。
ja.R: もし『神がヨハネを遣わされた』と言えば、イエスは『では、なぜヨハネを信じなかったのか？』と聞くだろう。

decisions.choice: believe him: believe John and his message
decisions.reason: "Him" is John. To believe him was to accept his call to repent and his witness to the one coming after him (1:7-8).

decisions.choice: he will say: Jesus
decisions.reason: The leaders expect Jesus to turn their answer against them.

decisions.choice: God sent him; Jesus; John
decisions.reason: Readable says what "from heaven" means and names the two men.

decisions.choice: "ông ta" for Jesus in the leaders' words, with no deity_pronoun span; Readable does not supply his name
decisions.reason: His opponents would not call him "ngài", so the English span becomes a plain pronoun, as in the Vietnamese John 12:19. A bare "Giê-xu" would be disrespectful and "Đức Giê-xu" is the narrator's honorific, so Readable keeps "ông ta", which is clear in context; "ông ấy" is John the Baptist.

decisions.choice: The leaders speak of Jesus among themselves as "그" / "예수" with no honorific
decisions.reason: In their own words the leaders do not honour him; the narrator still does (as in the Korean Mark 3:21-22).

decisions.choice: "वह कहेगा", "यीशु ... पूछेगा", plain
decisions.reason: As in Matthew 21:25: the narrative keeps the honorific for Jesus, but his opponents, speaking among themselves, would not; to his face they say "आप" (11:28).

decisions.choice: "ヨハネを" (B, R) for "him"
decisions.reason: Two men are "he" and "him" in one sentence; Balanced and Readable name John (m1) so that Japanese does not have "彼" for both. Literal keeps the pronouns. The leaders speak among themselves in the plain style.

source.text: ἀλλὰ εἴπωμεν· Ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἐφοβοῦντο τὸν ὄχλον, ἅπαντες γὰρ εἶχον τὸν Ἰωάννην ὄντως ὅτι προφήτης ἦν.

records.literal_gloss: But should we say, From men? They were fearing the crowd, for all were holding John really that a prophet he was.

en.L: But should we say, 'From {{gender:people|men}}'?"—they were afraid of the crowd, for all held that John had really been a prophet.
en.B: But suppose we say, 'From {{gender:human beings|men}}' . . ." They were afraid of the crowd, because everyone held that John was truly a prophet.
en.R: But what if we say, 'It came from {{gender:people|men}}'?" They were afraid of the crowd, because everyone was sure that John was a real prophet.

vi.L: Còn nếu chúng ta nói: 'Từ loài người' thì sao?"—họ sợ đám đông, vì mọi người đều cho rằng Giăng thật sự là một nhà tiên tri.
vi.B: Nhưng nếu chúng ta nói: 'Từ loài người' . . ." Họ sợ đám đông, vì ai nấy đều cho rằng Giăng thật là một nhà tiên tri.
vi.R: Nhưng nếu chúng ta nói: 'Đó là từ loài người' thì sao?" Họ sợ đám đông, vì ai cũng tin chắc rằng Giăng là một nhà tiên tri thật.

ko.L: 그렇다고 '사람들로부터'라고 말할까?" 그들은 무리를 두려워하고 있었다. 모두가 요한을 참으로 예언자였다고 여기고 있었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그렇다고 '사람에게서 온 것이다' 하자니..." 그들은 무리가 두려웠다. 모든 사람이 요한을 참 예언자로 여기고 있었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그렇다고 '사람들이 만든 것이다'라고 하면 어떻게 될까?" 그들은 사람들이 무서웠다. 모든 사람이 요한을 진짜 예언자라고 굳게 믿고 있었기 때문이다.

es.L: Pero ¿diremos: “De {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}”?»; temían a la multitud, porque todos tenían a Juan realmente por profeta.
es.B: Pero si decimos: “De {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}”...». Tenían miedo de la multitud, porque todos consideraban que Juan era de verdad un profeta.
es.R: Pero ¿y si decimos: “Vino de {{gender:la gente|los hombres}}”?». Tenían miedo de la multitud, porque todos estaban seguros de que Juan era un verdadero profeta.

fr.L: Mais dirons-nous : “{{gender:Des humains|Des hommes}}” ? » — ils craignaient la foule, car tous tenaient que Jean avait vraiment été un prophète.
fr.B: Mais si nous disons : “{{gender:Des humains|Des hommes}}”… » Ils avaient peur de la foule, car tout le monde tenait Jean pour un vrai prophète.
fr.R: Et si nous disons : “Il venait {{gender:des humains|des hommes}}” ? » Ils avaient peur de la foule, parce que tout le monde était sûr que Jean était un vrai prophète.

sw.L: Lakini tuseme, 'Kutoka kwa wanadamu'?"—walikuwa wakiuogopa umati, kwa maana wote walimwona Yohana kuwa kweli alikuwa nabii.
sw.B: Lakini tukisema, 'Ulitoka kwa wanadamu' . . ." Waliuogopa umati, kwa sababu kila mtu aliamini kwamba Yohana alikuwa nabii kweli.
sw.R: Lakini je, tukisema, 'Ulitoka kwa wanadamu'?" Waliuogopa umati, kwa sababu kila mtu alikuwa na hakika kwamba Yohana alikuwa nabii wa kweli.

pt.L: Mas devemos dizer: '{{gender:Das pessoas|Dos homens}}'?"—eles tinham medo da multidão, pois todos consideravam que João tinha sido realmente um profeta.
pt.B: Mas, se dissermos: '{{gender:Dos seres humanos|Dos homens}}'..." Eles tinham medo da multidão, porque todos consideravam João um verdadeiro profeta.
pt.R: Mas e se dissermos: 'Veio {{gender:das pessoas|dos homens}}'?" Eles tinham medo da multidão, porque todo mundo tinha certeza de que João era um profeta de verdade.

am.L: ነገር ግን “ከሰዎች” እንበልን?» ሕዝቡን ይፈሩ ነበር፤ ሁሉ ዮሐንስን በእውነት ነቢይ እንደ ነበረ ያምኑ ነበርና።
am.B: “ከሰዎች ነው” ብንልስ ...» ሕዝቡን ይፈሩ ነበር፤ ሁሉም ዮሐንስን በእርግጥ ነቢይ እንደ ሆነ ይቆጥሩት ነበርና።
am.R: ነገር ግን “ከሰዎች ነው” ብንልስ?» ሕዝቡን ይፈሩ ነበር፤ ምክንያቱም ሁሉም ዮሐንስ እውነተኛ ነቢይ እንደ ነበረ እርግጠኞች ነበሩ።

ru.L: А сказать: “От людей”?» — они боялись народа, потому что все считали, что Иоанн действительно был пророком.
ru.B: А если скажем: “От людей”…» Они боялись народа, потому что все считали Иоанна настоящим пророком.
ru.R: А что, если мы скажем: “Это было от людей”?» Они боялись толпы, потому что все были уверены, что Иоанн был настоящим пророком.

hi.L: पर क्या हम कहें, 'मनुष्यों से'?"—वे भीड़ से डरते थे, क्योंकि सब यूहन्ना को सचमुच भविष्यद्वक्ता मानते थे।
hi.B: पर मान लो हम कहें, 'मनुष्यों की ओर से' . . ." वे भीड़ से डरते थे, क्योंकि सब लोग मानते थे कि यूहन्ना सचमुच भविष्यद्वक्ता था।
hi.R: पर अगर हम कहें, 'वह लोगों की ओर से था,' तो क्या होगा?" वे भीड़ से डरते थे, क्योंकि सब लोगों को पक्का यक़ीन था कि यूहन्ना सच्चा नबी था।

uk.L: Але [чи] скажемо: “Від людей”?» — вони боялися натовпу, бо всі вважали, що Іван справді був пророком.
uk.B: Але якщо скажемо: “Від людей”…» Вони боялися натовпу, бо всі вважали, що Іван був справжнім пророком.
uk.R: А що, як ми скажемо: “Це було від людей”?» Вони боялися натовпу, бо всі були певні, що Іван був справжнім пророком.

ja.L: しかし、『人から』と言おうか？」――彼らは群衆を恐れていた。皆が、ヨハネは本当に預言者であったと考えていたからである。
ja.B: しかし、『人から』と言えば……」彼らは群衆を恐れていた。人々は皆、ヨハネが本当に預言者だったと考えていたからである。
ja.R: でも、『人から出たものだ』と言ったらどうなるだろう？」彼らは群衆がこわかったのです。みんなが、ヨハネは本物の預言者だったと信じていたからです。

decisions.choice: But should we say, From men?: the leaders do not finish the thought, and Mark completes it
alternatives: a full sentence: But we say, From men, and they feared the people
decisions.reason: The sentence breaks off. Mark explains why they could not give that answer: they feared the crowd. The words can also be read as a question they leave hanging.

decisions.choice: the crowd held John to be a prophet
decisions.reason: Crowds from all Judea and Jerusalem had gone out to John (1:5). Though Herod had put him to death (6:14-29), the people still honored him as a prophet.

decisions.choice: really: truly, in fact
decisions.reason: The word stresses that the people were convinced.

decisions.choice: the broken-off sentence
decisions.reason: Balanced shows that the leaders stop in mid-sentence, before Mark's explanation.

decisions.choice: "예언자" for prophetes
decisions.reason: The modern word the style guide prefers, as in the Korean John; "선지자" is the older Protestant word.

decisions.choice: the broken-off sentence: “De los seres humanos”...»
decisions.reason: As in English: Balanced lets the leaders' sentence break off, and Mark finishes the thought (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "भविष्यद्वक्ता" (L, B); "नबी" (R)
decisions.reason: The style guide's key term for prophet: the established church word at Literal and Balanced, the everyday "नबी" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "と言おうか？」――" (L); "と言えば……」" (B)
decisions.reason: The leaders break off and Mark finishes the thought (m1). Literal keeps their words as an unfinished question followed by a dash, Balanced lets the sentence trail off with "……", as the English does.

source.text: καὶ ἀποκριθέντες τῷ Ἰησοῦ λέγουσιν· Οὐκ οἴδαμεν.

records.literal_gloss: And answering to Jesus they say, Not we know.

en.L: And answering Jesus, they say, "We do not know."
en.B: So they replied to Jesus, "We do not know."
en.R: So they answered Jesus, "We do not know."

vi.L: Và họ trả lời Đức Giê-xu, nói: "Chúng tôi không biết."
vi.B: Vậy họ trả lời Đức Giê-xu: "Chúng tôi không biết."
vi.R: Vì thế họ trả lời Đức Giê-xu: "Chúng tôi không biết."

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 예수께 대답하여 말한다. "우리는 모르겠습니다."
ko.B: 그래서 그들은 예수께 "우리는 모르겠습니다" 하고 대답했다.
ko.R: 그래서 그들은 예수께 대답했다. "우리는 모르겠습니다."

es.L: Y respondiendo a Jesús, dicen: «No sabemos».
es.B: Así que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} respondieron a Jesús: «No lo sabemos».
es.R: Así que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} contestaron a Jesús: «No lo sabemos».

fr.L: Et répondant à Jésus, ils disent : « Nous ne savons pas. »
fr.B: Ils répondirent donc à Jésus : « Nous ne savons pas. »
fr.R: Alors ils ont répondu à Jésus : « Nous ne savons pas. »

sw.L: Na wakimjibu Yesu, wanasema, "Hatujui."
sw.B: Basi wakamjibu Yesu, "Hatujui."
sw.R: Kwa hiyo wakamjibu Yesu, "Hatujui."

pt.L: E, respondendo a Jesus, dizem: "Não sabemos."
pt.B: Então responderam a Jesus: "Não sabemos."
pt.R: Por isso eles responderam a Jesus: "Nós não sabemos."

am.L: ኢየሱስንም መልሰው «አናውቅም» ይሉታል።
am.B: ስለዚህ ለኢየሱስ «አናውቅም» ብለው መለሱለት።
am.R: ስለዚህ ለኢየሱስ «አናውቅም» ብለው መለሱለት።

ru.L: И, отвечая Иисусу, говорят: «Не знаем.»
ru.B: И они ответили Иисусу: «Мы не знаем.»
ru.R: Поэтому они ответили Иисусу: «Мы не знаем.»

hi.L: और वे यीशु को उत्तर देते हुए कहते हैं, "हम नहीं जानते।"
hi.B: तब उन्होंने यीशु को उत्तर दिया, "हम नहीं जानते।"
hi.R: तब उन्होंने यीशु को जवाब दिया, "हम नहीं जानते।"

uk.L: І, відповідаючи Ісусові, кажуть: «Не знаємо.»
uk.B: Тож вони відповіли Ісусові: «Ми не знаємо.»
uk.R: Тож вони відповіли Ісусові: «Ми не знаємо.»

ja.L: そして彼らはイエスに答えて言う。「わたしたちは知らない。」
ja.B: そこで彼らはイエスに答えた。「わからない。」
ja.R: それで彼らは、イエスに答えました。「わからない。」

decisions.choice: they say: present tense in a story about the past
decisions.reason: Mark again uses the present for vividness; the sense is past.

decisions.choice: we do not know: the leaders refuse to judge John's work
decisions.reason: They claim to judge Jesus' authority but will not say whether John was sent by God.

decisions.choice: So
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable show that the answer follows from their reasoning.

source.text: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς· Οὐδὲ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἐν ποίᾳ ἐξουσίᾳ ταῦτα ποιῶ.

records.literal_gloss: And Jesus says to them, Neither I tell you by what authority these things I do.

en.L: And Jesus says to them, "Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things."
en.B: Jesus said to them, "Then I am not telling you what authority I have for doing these things, either."
en.R: Jesus said to them, "Then I will not tell you who gave {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} the right to do these things."

vi.L: Và Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Ta cũng không nói cho các người biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm những việc này bởi thẩm quyền nào."
vi.B: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Vậy thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng không nói cho các người biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lấy thẩm quyền nào mà làm những việc này."
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu nói với họ: "Vậy thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng không cho các người biết ai đã cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} quyền làm những việc này."

ko.L: 그러자 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하신다. "나도 무슨 권한으로 이런 일들을 하는지 너희에게 말하지 않겠다."
ko.B: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "그렇다면 나도 무슨 권한으로 이런 일들을 하는지 너희에게 말하지 않겠다."
ko.R: 예수께서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. "그렇다면 나도 누가 나에게 이런 일을 할 권리를 주었는지 너희에게 말하지 않겠다."

es.L: Y Jesús les dice: «Tampoco yo {{plural_you:les|os}} digo con qué autoridad hago estas cosas».
es.B: Jesús les dijo: «Entonces tampoco yo {{plural_you:les|os}} digo con qué autoridad hago estas cosas».
es.R: Jesús les dijo: «Entonces yo tampoco {{plural_you:les|os}} diré quién {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dio el derecho de hacer estas cosas».

fr.L: Et Jésus leur dit : « Moi non plus, je ne vous dis pas par quelle autorité je fais ces choses. »
fr.B: Jésus leur dit : « Alors {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} non plus, je ne vous dis pas par quelle autorité je fais ces choses. »
fr.R: Jésus leur a dit : « Alors je ne vous dirai pas, {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} non plus, qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a donné le droit de faire ces choses. »

sw.L: Na Yesu anawaambia, "Wala {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} siwaambii ni kwa mamlaka gani nafanya mambo haya."
sw.B: Yesu akawaambia, "Basi {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} pia sitawaambia nina mamlaka gani ya kufanya mambo haya."
sw.R: Yesu akawaambia, "Basi sitawaambia ni nani aliyenipa ruhusa ya kufanya mambo haya."

pt.L: E Jesus lhes diz: "Nem eu digo a vocês com que autoridade faço estas coisas."
pt.B: Jesus lhes disse: "Então eu também não vou dizer a vocês que autoridade tenho para fazer estas coisas."
pt.R: Jesus disse a eles: "Então eu também não vou dizer a vocês quem {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} deu o direito de fazer estas coisas."

am.L: ኢየሱስም «እኔም በምን ሥልጣን እነዚህን እንደማደርግ አልነግራችሁም» ይላቸዋል።
am.B: ኢየሱስም «እንግዲያውስ እኔም እነዚህን ነገሮች በምን ሥልጣን እንደማደርግ አልነግራችሁም» አላቸው።
am.R: ኢየሱስም «እንግዲያውስ እኔም እነዚህን ነገሮች ለማድረግ ሥልጣን የሰጠኝ ማን እንደ ሆነ አልነግራችሁም» አላቸው።

ru.L: И Иисус говорит им: «И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не говорю вам, какой властью это делаю.»
ru.B: Иисус сказал им: «Тогда и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не скажу вам, какой властью {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} это делаю.»
ru.R: Иисус сказал им: «Тогда и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не скажу вам, кто дал {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} право это делать.»

hi.L: और यीशु उनसे कहते हैं, "मैं भी तुम्हें नहीं बताता कि मैं ये काम किस अधिकार से करता हूँ।"
hi.B: यीशु ने उनसे कहा, "तो मैं भी तुम्हें नहीं बताता कि मैं किस अधिकार से ये काम करता हूँ।"
hi.R: यीशु ने उनसे कहा, "तो मैं भी तुम्हें नहीं बताऊँगा कि मुझे ये काम करने का हक़ किसने दिया।"

uk.L: І Ісус каже їм: «І {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не кажу вам, якою владою це роблю.»
uk.B: Ісус сказав їм: «Тоді й {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не скажу вам, яку владу маю, щоб це робити.»
uk.R: Ісус сказав їм: «Тоді й {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не скажу вам, хто дав {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}} право це робити.»

ja.L: するとイエスは彼らに言われる。「わたしも、何の権威によってこれらのことをするのか、あなたがたに言わない。」
ja.B: イエスは彼らに言われた。「それなら、何の権威でこのようなことをしているのか、わたしもあなたがたに言わないでおこう。」
ja.R: イエスは彼らに言われました。「それなら、だれがわたしにこういうことをする権利を与えたのか、わたしも言わないでおこう。」

decisions.choice: neither I: Jesus matches their refusal
decisions.reason: The emphatic "I" sets his answer beside theirs: since you will not say, I will not say.

decisions.choice: the answer is implied: his authority comes from the same source as John's
decisions.reason: John pointed to Jesus (1:7-8), and Jesus was baptized by John when the voice from heaven spoke (1:9-11). The parable that follows (12:1-12) makes his claim plainer.

decisions.choice: Then
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the link to their answer clear.
